body: r23-plugins (2026-10-07): twofactor Reset leaves the user's sessions alive; terms history stores no IP or user agent; the history backfill keeps only the latest acceptance; phone list and make-primary routes exist only under phone.Multiple(); username availability check limited to 30/min per IP by default. CHANGELOG: resend revokes old verify links; username available limit; twofactor Reset/Unlock; phone.Multiple; terms history (re-accept is now a no-op).
